extracted.intended_audience: writers, translators, editors, and publishers seeking information about PEN America literary awards and submission eligibility
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/award criteria for multiple PEN America literary prizes and grants covering fiction, poetry, nonfiction, translation, drama, children's literature, sports writing, and editing. Includes prize amounts, target works/authors, and occasional frequency notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Literary Awards program scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN Literary Awards are the most comprehensive in the United States; each year PEN confers more than $150,000 to writers in the fields of fiction, science writing, essays, sports writing, biography, children’s literature, translation, drama, or poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program-level description of scope and total funds distributed annually; implies awards cover a wide range of genres and formats and are intended to recognize literary excellence across those fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Robert W. Bingham Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: For an outstanding work of debut fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $25,000; targets debut fiction (first published book) judged outstanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Joyce Osterweil Award for Poetry
rubrics_metrics.description: For a new and emerging American poet with promise of further literary achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $5,000; targeted at early-career American poets showing promise.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Diamonstein-Spielvogel Award for the Art of the Essay
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/Diamonstein-Spielvogel Award for the Art of the Essay aims to preserve the dignity and esteem that the essay form imparts to literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $10,000; recognizes excellence in essay writing and the literary value of the essay form.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Laura Pels International Foundation for Theater Award
rubrics_metrics.description: A pair of awards from PEN and the Laura Pels International Foundation for Theater honor a Grand Master of American Theater and an outstanding new voice; for an American Playwright in Mid-Career and a Master American Dramatist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $7,500; two awards recognizing both a mid-career American playwright and a master dramatist (life achievement).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Translation Prize
rubrics_metrics.description: For a distinguished book-length prose translation published in 2012.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $3,000; eligibility tied to book-length prose translations published in the specified year (2012 on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Open Book Award (formerly Beyond Margins Awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Invites submissions of book-length writings by authors of color, published in the United States during the current calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $5,000; eligibility limited to book-length works by authors of color published in the U.S. in the relevant year.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN Award for Poetry in Translation
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN Award for Poetry in Translation is conferred every year in New York.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $3,000; annual award recognizing excellence in poetry translation; venue/location noted (New York).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/John Kenneth Galbraith Award for Nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: This biennial prize of $10,000 will go to the author of a distinguished book of general nonfiction possessing notable literary merit and critical perspective and illuminating important...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biennial award ($10,000) for a distinguished general nonfiction book that combines literary merit with critical perspective and illuminates significant subjects; truncated description on page suggests emphasis on importance and perspective.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Jacqueline Bograd Weld Award for Biography
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/Jacqueline Bograd Weld Award for Biography is awarded for excellence in the art of biography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $5,000; recognizes high-quality biographical writing (excellence in the craft of biography).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Phyllis Naylor Working Writer Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/Phyllis Naylor Working Writer Fellowship of $5,000 is offered annually to an author of children's or young-adult fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual $5,000 fellowship specifically for authors writing children's or YA fiction; intended as working support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation Fund Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN Translation Fund was established in the summer of 2003 by a gift of $730,000 from an anonymous donor in response to the dismayingly low number of literary translations currently appearing...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants listed as $2,000–$4,000; program created to increase number of literary translations; implies eligibility for translation projects and support for translators/publishers to bring translated works into English.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/E. O. Wilson Literary Science Writing Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/E. O. Wilson Literary Science Writing Award celebrates writing that exemplifies literary excellence on the subject of physical and biological sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $10,000; recognizes literary excellence in science writing focused on physical and biological sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Nora Magid Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/Nora Magid Award, established in 1993, honors a magazine editor whose high literary standards and taste have, throughout his or her career, contributed significantly to the excellence of...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $2,500; intended for magazine editors who have maintained high literary standards and contributed to editorial excellence (career achievement emphasis).

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/Steven Kroll Award for Picture Book Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/Steven Kroll Award was established in memory of Steven Kroll to acknowledge the distinct literary contributions of picture book writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $5,000; recognizes literary achievement specifically in picture book writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/ESPN Award for Literary Sports Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: The $5,000 PEN/ESPN Award for Literary Sports Writing honors a nonfiction book about sports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual prize ($5,000) for a nonfiction book focused on sports; emphasizes literary quality in sports writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: PEN/ESPN Lifetime Achievement Award for Literary Sports Writing
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN/ESPN Lifetime Achievement Award for Literary Sports Writing, which was conferred for the first time in the fall of 2011, is given to one living American or U.S.-based writer each year to...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prize amount listed as $5,000; annual lifetime-achievement award for a living American or U.S.-based writer recognizing long-term contribution to literary sports writing (page text truncated).
